router_balance_nonzero.meaning: the TrailsRouter contract holds a non-zero ERC20 or ETH balance
router_balance_nonzero.evidence: If any tokens or ETH ever sit on the router contract, a malicious user can drain all router-held funds via a single injectAndCall call.

inject_and_call_public_no_guard.meaning: injectAndCall is public and lacks an onlyDelegatecall guard, so it can be invoked directly
inject_and_call_public_no_guard.evidence: Because injectAndCall is public and not protected by onlyDelegatecall, anyone can call it directly on the router contract.
